import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Data provided by the user as a string
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame using io.StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set a clean style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axes for the plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
# Color points by Stress Level and size points by Physical Activity Level to add more dimensions

    data=df,
    x="Sleep Duration",
    y="Quality of Sleep",
    hue="Stress Level",       # Color points based on Stress Level
    size="Physical Activity Level", # Size points based on Physical Activity Level
    sizes=(50, 400),          # Define the range of point sizes
    palette="viridis",        # Use a perceptually uniform color palette
    legend="full",            # Show the full legend for hue and size
    alpha=0.8                 # Set transparency for points
)

# Add titles and labels for clarity
plt.title("Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by Stress Level and Physical Activity", fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel("Sleep Duration (hours)", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)", fontsize=12)

# Adjust legend position to not overlap with the plot
plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0)

# Ensure all elements fit within the figure
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot as 'output.png'
